func Example[T any](name string) (T, error)
func Forwarded(_ context.Context, wire bitwire.Endpoint) (bitwire.Endpoint, func(), error)
func Local(_ context.Context, wire bitwire.Endpoint) (bitwire.Endpoint, func(), error)
func Mounted(_ context.Context, wire bitwire.Endpoint) (bitwire.Endpoint, func(), error)
func Pair[AEnvelope runtime.Of[ATag], BEnvelope runtime.Of[BTag], ATag any, BTag any](ctx context.Context, model protocol.ClientModel[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], options Options, adapterAEnvelope runtime.ValueAdapter[AEnvelope], adapterBEnvelope runtime.ValueAdapter[BEnvelope]) (protocol.ClientModel[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], func(), error)
func Pipe(ctx context.Context, wire bitwire.Endpoint) (bitwire.Endpoint, func(), error)
func Smoke[AEnvelope runtime.Of[ATag], BEnvelope runtime.Of[BTag], ATag any, BTag any](ctx context.Context, model protocol.ClientModel[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], opposite protocol.Server[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], options Options, adapterAEnvelope runtime.ValueAdapter[AEnvelope], adapterBEnvelope runtime.ValueAdapter[BEnvelope]) error
type Options struct{Context runtime.AdapterContext; RemoteContext runtime.AdapterContext; Presentation Presentation; Inputs map[string]any; Equal func(string, any, any) error}
type Presentation func(context.Context, bitwire.Endpoint) (bitwire.Endpoint, func(), error)
